summary: The PR addresses a micro-optimization by avoiding unnecessary validator creation in CharField, which improves performance without breaking functionality.

issues.description: The change introduces a new behavior where the MaxLengthValidator is not added if max_length is None, but there are no additional tests to verify this behavior. This could lead to unexpected behavior if someone relies on the presence of the validator.
There is no documentation update to reflect the change in behavior regarding the MaxLengthValidator.
